description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Mona Lisa.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mona Lisa, Science Geek
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
